scope: Widen the open-source ACIS semantic survey by separating parser and geometry-kernel lineage, checking a potential non-OCCT kernel route, and screening broad format claims against detailed support tables.

method.kind: Public primary project documentation and manifests
method.evidenceBoundary: Repository documentation and manifests identify candidate scope and dependencies only. No code path was built or executed, source lineage was not audited beyond the published dependency edge, and no output was treated as geometry evidence.

observed: The README describes an optional acis feature that lifts a SatDocument to the project's B-rep and says the implementation is early with most operations unwritten.
The reviewed Cargo.toml defines acis as a feature including brep and an optional opencadcodec dependency pinned to git revision f385f75.
The OpenCADStudio tessellation documentation describes an analytic kernel route and an explicitly incomplete per-surface fallback.

evidence.planUse: At an existing composed checkpoint only, pin app/codec/kernel revisions, feature set and toolchain; verify operation availability; run the identical exact payload against independently authored analytic expectations and the existing distinct-kernel candidate. Keep parser, kernel, display, and native-acceptance results separate.

observed: The broad overview advertises many format categories including ACIS.
The detailed ACIS SAT/SAB support-table row marks read and write unsupported.
evidence.planUse: Exclude from the current ACIS reader/kernel quorum unless a later exact source revision changes the detailed capability row and exposes a runnable route.

observed: The project extracts SAT spline geometry and trim curves into JSON for geomdl.
The documented build/run prerequisites include the commercial 3D ACIS Modeler.
evidence.planUse: At most a later licensed NURBS-extraction comparison on an exactly matched profile; not part of the open-source semantic quorum or normal implementation workflow.

cadmpeg remains a separately recorded direct-stream parser/IR candidate with existing artifact, profile, and lineage limitations.
evidence.planUse: Do not count multiple project frontends converging on OCCT as independent kernel votes; preserve exact parser and kernel identity separately.
